lead.title: Nyxoah moves to enforce its Unified Patent Court win: Inspire must stop selling its stimulator in four European countries
lead.deck: On November 23, the Belgian medtech said it is enforcing the default decision issued on November 16 by the Munich local division of the Unified Patent Court (UPC) on its patent EP 2 760 534: Inspire Medical Systems must stop offering, selling, using, importing or storing infringing products in Germany, France, the Netherlands and Belgium, recall and destroy those placed on the market since March 31, 2021, and pay damages to be set in separate proceedings. In hypoglossal nerve stimulation for sleep apnea, this could flip the balance of power in Europe — and shows how much a unitary patent can do for a challenger medtech against the market leader.

milestone.title: Yaqrit signs Chinese distribution for Dialive, its CE-marked liver dialysis system
milestone.summary: Its subsidiary Cytox Lifesciences has appointed Guorun International Medical Group to distribute Dialive, a CE-marked extracorporeal device for patients with advanced liver disease, starting with hospitals in the Boao Lecheng medical tourism pilot zone (Hainan); treated patients will join post-marketing studies modelled on the UK ALIVER 2.0 trial. A letter of intent also covers Carbalive, its oral adsorbent, once it is CE-marked.
milestone.why: Boao Lecheng allows devices already approved abroad to be used in China before national registration: a rare shortcut into a market of roughly 7 million cirrhosis patients, and a source of real-world data for a young London company whose CE mark is its key asset.

brefsEurope.title: University of Bern spin-off PolaSight wins CHF 150,000 from Venture Kick for its polarized-light tissue imaging
brefsEurope.summary: The PolaOne platform analyses fresh tissue in about 60 seconds, without staining, using Mueller-matrix polarimetry and AI, with intraoperative frozen-section analysis as its first application. The funds will expand clinical studies with partner hospitals and prepare regulatory steps, a week after the start-up won the Falling Walls Lab global final.

brefsEurope.title: NIHR puts £10M into EDITH, the world's largest trial of AI-assisted breast cancer screening
brefsEurope.summary: Nearly 700,000 women will be enrolled at 30 UK centres, led by the universities of Warwick and Cambridge and Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, working with NHS England. The trial will test whether AI can replace one of the two radiologists in mammography double reading: a reference market for European breast-imaging AI vendors.

brefsEurope.title: 3Shape plugs its Dx Plus AI dental diagnostics into Henry Schein One practice software
brefsEurope.summary: Integrating 3Shape Unite with Dentrix, Ascend and Dentally puts TRIOS 6 scans and Dx Plus visualizations (caries, plaque, wear, gingival recession) directly into the patient record across North America, the UK, Australia and parts of Europe. The Danish company is pushing its AI into tens of thousands of practices already running a third-party system.

brefsEurope.title: A large Danish region rolls out Sectra's imaging case-based training portal
brefsEurope.summary: The region's hospitals can now train staff on anonymized patient cases via the Sectra Education Portal, a cloud component of its enterprise imaging suite; the initial order covers at least 250 users per month, with room to grow, after a national launch in Norway this year.

brefsEurope.title: Smith + Nephew names Nick Alexos, former CFO of Univar and Dentsply Sirona, as finance chief
brefsEurope.summary: He starts on November 30, succeeding John Rogers, who left for Baxter in September; a 30-year Madison Dearborn Partners veteran, he steered Univar's $8B take-private by Apollo. Chair Rupert Soames highlighted his M&A and capital-allocation record: a comparable to watch for orthopedics consolidation.

word.definition: AI software reads every screening mammogram, assigns a risk score and flags suspicious areas, to triage exams and support — or even replace — one of the two human readers.

parts.label: Risk score
parts.role: ranks exams from most normal to most suspicious

parts.label: Workflow integration
parts.role: connects the AI to the PACS and the double-reading setup

how.t: Screening images are sent to the software, which marks suspicious areas and computes a malignancy score.
Low-score exams go to single reading, high-score exams to reinforced double reading: the protocol tested in Sweden's MASAI trial.
The radiologist keeps the recall decision; the AI acts as an aid or a second reader depending on its approval.

word.why: With radiologists in short supply, breast screening is the most mature AI use case in imaging: the randomized MASAI trial (Lancet, 2026) showed higher sensitivity and 12% fewer interval cancers, and NIHR is funding EDITH across 700,000 women. The VC question is shifting from algorithm performance to reimbursement and the right to autonomous reading — where European players are ahead.

startups.name: ScreenPoint Medical
startups.use: Its Transpara software is the AI used in Sweden's randomized MASAI trial

startups.name: Vara
startups.use: AI screening platform that handled nearly 40% of mammograms in Germany's national programme at the time of its $8.9M raise
